# Town of Troy municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 24; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Robert Langlands (Chair), Anne Quirion, and Gaston Bathalon for Troy's three-member board

Town of Troy, Selectboard page (troyvt.gov): lists the same three members. On March 1, 2022 the town voted to hire New England Municipal Consultants to perform the duties of the listers' office (town Assessors page), so no lister post is created
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Terri Medley as Troy's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Terri Medley as Troy's Town Clerk

Town of Troy, Town Clerk & Treasurer page (troyvt.gov): Terri Medley holds both offices. She is also Chair of the Village of North Troy Board of Trustees (batch 17); one person record carries all three memberships
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Terri Medley as Troy's Town Treasurer

Town of Troy, Town Clerk & Treasurer page (troyvt.gov): Terri Medley holds both offices
